title: No regular icosahedron has a rational point on every face: a proof checked in Lean
description:
A proof that no regular icosahedron in R3 has a point with rational coordinates on each of its twenty closed faces, answering a question of I. Bogdanov on MathOverflow (question 452847). The proof reduces the problem, by a field automorphism of C sending √5 to −√5, to a separation statement for complex orthogonal matrices, which is proved by a computer-assisted case analysis with exact polynomial bounds over Z[φ]. The repository contains the paper and a complete formal proof in Lean 4 / Mathlib; the 48 certificates are checked by the Lean kernel (decide +kernel), and the main theorem depends only on the standard axioms.

The mathematical argument was developed by OpenAI Codex and the Lean formalization by Anthropic Claude, under the direction of the author.
